structured_output.what_is_happening: A dormant Bags.fm token from May 2025 (FINN, named after Bags founder Finn, with the X account @FinnOnBagsApp, formerly "100MilFinn") suddenly woke up. All of its 24h volume (~$40k across 631 transactions, 142 unique buyers and 129 unique sellers) happened in roughly the last 15 minutes. The pump took it about +139% to ~$18k market cap, and the latest 5 minutes are already down 31-38% with sellers outnumbering buyers (68 vs 52 unique). GMGN flags a paid DexScreener boost, a profile update and community-takeover status. I found no news or organic catalyst.

narrative.description: The token trades on the name of the Bags founder (finnbags) / the Bags platform. It is not a new event. Bags.fm is a real, sizable launchpad, but I found no current Finn/Bags news (the latest press I found is from March 2026).
narrative.why_spreading: The best-supported explanation is a CTO revival with a paid DexScreener boost and profile update. The burst of activity is concentrated in about 15 minutes and is already retracing. I found no organic trigger.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the oldest $FINN Bags token, with the project X account @FinnOnBagsApp, 1,446 holders and burned LP. It is plausibly the 'original' FINN on Bags, though it is not an official Bags token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Many copycat 'Finn Bags' tokens exist (pump.fun and BAGS). All are dead, at <$8k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN shows a paid DexScreener boost, a profile update and community-takeover status. It also shows 140 bundler-tagged wallets and a 26% bot/degen rate. The volume came suddenly, all within about 15 minutes. Searches turned up no independent discussion.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is inaccessible (402), so any CTO posts or KOL calls are invisible to me.

structured_output.thesis: This is a promoted CTO revival of a 16-month-old Bags token. The ~15-minute pump is already fading hard, sellers now outnumber buyers, and I found no organic catalyst. LP is burned, so a pull-rug is unlikely, but the most likely path is a bleed or chop back toward the pre-pump ~$7k market cap. A 2x from entry needs a second wave of promotion.
